title: Istio Service Mesh Traffic Flow
summary: istiod pushes config to Envoy sidecars, which enforce mTLS and traffic rules defined by VirtualService and DestinationRule objects.

nodes.label: External Client
nodes.detail: Sends requests to the mesh edge over HTTPS.

nodes.label: Ingress Gateway
nodes.detail: A standalone Envoy that accepts external traffic. Its listeners are configured by Gateway and VirtualService resources.

nodes.label: istiod
nodes.detail: Converts Istio resources into Envoy config via xDS, and acts as a certificate authority issuing workload certificates.

nodes.label: VirtualService
nodes.detail: Defines how requests are routed: match on headers or paths, split traffic by weight, add retries, timeouts or fault injection.

nodes.label: DestinationRule
nodes.detail: Defines subsets by pod label, load balancing policy, connection pools and outlier detection for a destination.

nodes.label: Sidecar Envoy A
nodes.detail: Intercepts all pod traffic, originates mTLS with its workload certificate and applies routing rules.

nodes.label: Frontend App
nodes.detail: Application container unaware of mTLS and routing; it talks plain HTTP to localhost.

nodes.label: Sidecar Envoy B
nodes.detail: Terminates mTLS, verifies caller identity, enforces authorization policy and emits metrics and traces.

nodes.label: Backend v1/v2
nodes.detail: Backend pods with version labels. Subsets let VirtualService send a percentage of traffic to v2 for canaries.

steps.title: Rules become config
steps.text: VirtualService and DestinationRule objects are read by istiod and translated to Envoy configuration.

steps.title: istiod pushes xDS
steps.text: istiod streams routes, clusters and certificates to every sidecar and gateway.

steps.title: Gateway admits traffic
steps.text: The ingress gateway accepts external HTTPS and routes per VirtualService.

steps.title: Sidecars secure the hop
steps.text: Envoy A opens an mTLS connection to Envoy B; both verify SPIFFE identities.

steps.title: Subsets split traffic
steps.text: DestinationRule subsets and weights decide whether the request reaches v1 or v2.
